"for up to 6 months" exceeds 90 days of assistance
"within 30 days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data"

reasons: The document had no transition-assistance or data-return obligation; a single concise new 10.3 was inserted, which is the minimal fix for an absent clause.

All preferred atomic elements are express: 6-month assistance, then-current rates, 30-day return from expiry or termination, standard machine-readable format, deletion after return, and written certification.
The return deadline runs from expiry or termination rather than a Customer request, and is not tied to an individual Order Form, so mandatory return is not conditioned away.

Existing 10.1 and 10.2 (access wind-down, Deliverable delivery, refunds) are untouched and remain effective; only defined terms already in use (Customer Data, Vendor, Agreement) are relied upon, so no dangling mechanic or contradiction is introduced.
